description: One startup pack in full: each pick with category, Proven Score, band, portfolio usage, its deal (claim_url for public deals), where it is available and the reason it was picked, plus claim_all_url to claim every public deal with one sign-in. With country, a pick not available there is replaced by the next vendor in its category that is (or left out if none is).

country.description: Optional: where the company is registered, as a country name or ISO code. Swaps out picks not available there.

slug.description: Pack slug (e.g. early-stage-startup-pack), title, or pack URL. get_packs lists them.

name: get_pack
title: Get a startup pack
